ruleset:
Nitpicker Reactor rules: no blocking calls on the threads that run a reactive chain.
<rule name="ReactorBlockingInOperator" language="java" class="net.sourceforge.pmd.lang.rule.xpath.XPathRule" message="Move this blocking call off the Reactor event loop: wrap it as Mono.fromCallable(() -> blocking()).subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic()) inside flatMap, or add publishOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic()) earlier in the chain, or use a non-blocking client. A blocking call inside an operator runs on the thread that serves every other request, so it stalls them all until it returns.""> 2
let $operators := ('map', 'mapNotNull', 'flatMap', 'flatMapMany', 'flatMapIterable', 'flatMapSequential', 'concatMap', 'switchMap', 'filter', 'handle', 'doOnNext', 'doOnSuccess', 'doOnError', 'doOnEach', 'doOnComplete', 'doOnTerminate', 'doAfterTerminate', 'doFinally', 'onErrorResume', 'onErrorReturn', 'onErrorMap', 'zipWith', 'reduce', 'scan', 'subscribe'), $reactive := function($node) { $node[pmd-java:typeIs('reactor.core.publisher.Mono') or pmd-java:typeIs('reactor.core.publisher.Flux')] }, $file := function($node) { exists($node[pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.FileInputStream') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.FileOutputStream') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.FileReader') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.FileWriter') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.RandomAccessFile')]) }, $blocking := function($call) { exists($call[self::ConstructorCall][$file(.)]) or exists($call[self::MethodCall][not(*[1][self::ConstructorCall][$file(.)])][pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Thread#sleep(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.nio.file.Files#_(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.sql.DriverManager#getConnection(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.net.InetAddress#getByName(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.net.InetAddress#getAllByName(_*)') or (@MethodName = ('block', 'blockFirst', 'blockLast', 'blockOptional') and exists($reactive(*[1]))) or (@MethodName = ('get', 'join') and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Future')])) or (@MethodName = 'join' and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread')])) or (@MethodName = 'await' and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CyclicBarrier')])) or (@MethodName = ('take', 'put') and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue')])) or (@MethodName = ('acquire', 'acquireUninterruptibly') and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Semaphore')])) or (@MethodName = ('lock', 'lockInterruptibly') and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.locks.Lock')])) or (@MethodName = 'waitFor' and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Process')])) or (@MethodName = ('execute', 'executeQuery', 'executeUpdate', 'executeBatch', 'executeLargeUpdate') and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.sql.Statement')])) or (@MethodName = 'next' and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.sql.ResultSet')])) or (@MethodName = ('prepareStatement', 'createStatement', 'prepareCall', 'commit', 'rollback') and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.sql.Connection')])) or (@MethodName = 'getConnection' and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('javax.sql.DataSource')])) or (@MethodName = ('read', 'readAllBytes', 'readNBytes', 'skip') and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.InputStream')])) or (@MethodName = 'write' and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.OutputStream')])) or (@MethodName = ('readLine', 'read', 'lines') and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.BufferedReader')])) or (@MethodName = 'send' and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.net.http.HttpClient')])) or (@MethodName = ('openStream', 'openConnection') and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.net.URL')])) or (@MethodName = ('getInputStream', 'getResponseCode') and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.net.URLConnection')])) or (@MethodName = 'execute' and exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('okhttp3.Call')])) or exists(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcOperations') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.jdbc.core.namedparam.NamedParameterJdbcOperations') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.EntityManager')]) and not(@MethodName = ('toString', 'equals', 'hashCode', 'getClass'))]) }, $offloaded := function($operator) { let $upstream := $operator/*[1] return exists( ($operator/ancestor::MethodCall | $upstream/descendant-or-self::MethodCall [not(ancestor::ArgumentList intersect $upstream/descendant::ArgumentList)]) [@MethodName = ('subscribeOn', 'publishOn')] [not(ArgumentList/MethodCall[@MethodName = ('parallel', 'single', 'immediate')][*[1][self::TypeExpression]])]) or exists($upstream/descendant-or-self::VariableAccess[not(ancestor::ArgumentList intersect $upstream/descendant::ArgumentList)] [exists($reactive(.))]) } return for $operator in //MethodCall[@MethodName = $operators][exists($reactive(*[1]))][not($offloaded(.))], $lambda in $operator/ArgumentList/LambdaExpression return $lambda//*[$blocking(.)] [ancestor::LambdaExpression[1] is $lambda] [not(ancestor::*[self::ClassBody or self::MethodDeclaration] intersect $lambda//*)]
<rule name="ReactorBlockInReactiveMethod" language="java" class="net.sourceforge.pmd.lang.rule.xpath.XPathRule" message="Return the inner publisher through flatMap or zipWith instead of calling block(). This method returns a Mono or Flux, so its caller runs on an event-loop thread, where block() stalls every other request (Reactor throws IllegalStateException on those threads).""> 2
//MethodDeclaration[ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('reactor.core.publisher.Mono') or pmd-java:typeIs('reactor.core.publisher.Flux') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.reactivestreams.Publisher')]] /Block//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('block', 'blockFirst', 'blockLast', 'blockOptional')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('reactor.core.publisher.Mono') or pmd-java:typeIs('reactor.core.publisher.Flux')]] [ancestor::*[self::LambdaExpression or self::MethodDeclaration or self::ClassBody][1][self::MethodDeclaration]]
